facets.label: lens-data-model
facets.description: Pure TypeScript types for Lens, Facet, Rule, and Finder patterns
facets.reason: Core domain model; dependency-free and shared across server, TUI, and VSCode

facets.label: rule-evaluation-engine
facets.description: Evaluates pattern, symbol, diff, and structural rules against repository files
facets.reason: Where deterministic marking happens; handles git integration and memoization for performance

facets.label: lens-persistence
facets.description: Read-modify-write store with ownership enforcement, consent checks, and history recording
facets.reason: How Lenses are mutated safely; enforces user/agent ownership model and records audit trail

facets.label: activity-tracking
facets.description: Derives per-turn agent activity (reads, edits, searches) from message store and active Lens
facets.reason: Enables visualization of agent work; live derivation from message store, recolored on Lens switch

facets.label: color-system
facets.description: xterm-256 color palette contract; categorical and ordinal palettes with pinned facet colors
facets.reason: Ensures color consistency across server, TUI, and VSCode; C1 contract prevents color drift
